messages:
lina: Heads-up  BioLattice finished their interview and sent back copy + a couple redlines. Need legal + final asset checklist before we can schedule the webinar mention.

ash: Can you paste the redlines? Ill prep the launch post draft and slide frames.

lina: Paste from their doc: 
> Customer wants to remove specific perf numbers and avoid microscope-level configuration details. Also asked to shorten the quote to one sentence.

matt-cs: Confirmed with BioLattice CS: they prefer shorter quote and no raw benchmark metrics in public collateral. Theyre OK with a general statement about "improved throughput and cost efficiency."

claire-legal: Okay. We need a signed release + a clear single-sentence quote. We can accept the soft wording; make sure we do not include any internal appendix in external slide decks. Also ask the customers counsel to initial the release (they can do that in the doc tomorrow).

photography-bot: Asset checklist reminder: headshot (preferably 3000px), company logo (svg + png), 1-line bio, approved quote card, and a hero image option. Upload to /shared/marketing/assets/biolattice/.

ash: Draft hero headline for the blog: "BioLattice scales model inference and accelerates iteration with Redwood Inference"

lina: Nice start. Keep it neutral on numbers. Add a webinar CTA and call out the case study PDF at the end.

ash: Draft subhead: "A Life Sciences platform reduced serving friction and unlocked production workflows using Redwood Inference." Placeholder for quote: "{QUOTE_GOES_HERE}"  BioLattice.

matt-cs: On the customer quote, propose: "Redwood Inference helped us reduce serving friction and accelerate deployments, enabling more rapid model improvements."

lina: That looks good and short. Matt  can you confirm with the customer and ask for counsel sign-off?

matt-cs: Pinged them. Also asked for a preferred headshot and logo variant.

claire-legal: When they return the signed release, add a short clause granting Redwood permission to use their logo in product marketing and webinars. Standard stuff.

photography-bot: Noted: we also need a landscape thumbnail 1200x628 for socials.

ash: Timeline: if customer signs release by Thu noon we can:
- Thu afternoon: lock copy and slides
- Thu 11:59pm PT: embargoed publish
- Fri morning: go live + announce + run webinar promotional run for next week

lina: If counsel delays, we can still schedule the webinar but remove the direct quote card and use the anonymized summary in slides. Keep me posted.

matt-cs: Update  customer legal replied: they approved the short quote above and will sign the release by EOD today. Sending the signed doc in the drive now.

claire-legal: Reviewed the signed release and initialed the logo permissions. Redwood side signs off on the wording.

design: I've started the slide snippet (hero + 1 customer highlight). No numbers, just arrow chart showing relative improvement with caption: "Representative improvement shown; specific metrics omitted at customer's request."

lina: Perfect. Can we get a final quick eyeball on the hero copy and slide tonight? I'm planning to queue the post for Thu 23:59 PT if all looks good.

ash: Posting draft here in ~30m for review. Thanks team. :rocket:
